articles.title: Why is the World's Best Tennis Player Worried About a Guy He's Beaten 9 Times in a Row?
articles.summary: Jannik Sinner hasn't lost to Alexander Zverev in nine matches, but he's nervous for the Wimbledon final. Zverev just won his first Grand Slam, and that changes everything. The match is on Sunday.

articles.title: Matt Damon Loves the Memes About Him Getting Stranded—and He Wants More!
articles.summary: Actor Matt Damon has been stranded in so many movies that it's become a joke. He says the memes are funny and he's ready to get stuck again. His new movie, The Odyssey, is in theaters July 17.

articles.title: Oops! 10 Double Faults and a Super-Fast Loss—But This Tennis Champ Still Smiled
articles.summary: Alfie Hewett lost the Wimbledon wheelchair final 6-1, 6-1 to Tokito Oda. He served 10 double faults, but still joked that Oda "didn't read the script." Oda has now won six Grand Slams in a row.
